content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. S teɣnint n ‘Ict n tedbirt ibekkmem deg imucan iggʷejen’. N Dawud. Tira ineqcen, řami t ṭṭfen Ifilisṭiniyyen di Jat.
Ḥinn xafi, a AREBBI, maɣar ijj n bnadem yarezzu ad ayi isarḍ, iḥeṣṣar ayi umjahed ass marra.
Inni d ayi iḥeṣṣaren xsen ad ayi ṣarḍen ass marra, maɣar inni kidi ittmenɣan s nnfaxet, aqa aten deg waṭṭas!
Deg wass i di i ɣa ggʷedeɣ, ad xak ttecřeɣ,
x AREBBI, wenni umi ɣa ṣebḥeɣ awař nnes, x AREBBI i ttecřeɣ, war tteggʷideɣ ca, maɣar min zemmaren ad ayi ggen midden?
Nitni qeǧben awařen inu ass ikmeř, marra tnawi nsen aqa aten xafi d řɣar.
Nitni munen, nuffaren, nitni ḥeṭṭan inarziwen inu, xmi arezzun ad nɣen řeɛmar inu.
Ma zemmaren ad arewřen waxxa ggin řɣecc? Sehwa řegnus deg weɣḍab nnec, a AREBBI!
Cek tḥessbed ussan n weṭlaɛ inu. Egg imeṭṭawen inu di tzeyyat n waman nnec, - ma war ǧin deg wedlis nnec? -
xenni ad dewřen řɛedyan inu ɣar ḍeffar, deg wass umi ɣa řaɣiɣ. Necc ssneɣ aya: AREBBI aqa-t akidi.
X AREBBI, wenni umi ɣa ssemɣareɣ awař nnes, x SIDI, wenni umi ɣa ssemɣareɣ awař nnes,
x AREBBI i xef ttecřeɣ, war tteggʷideɣ ca, maɣar min izemmar bnadem ad ayi yegg?
Xafi, a AREBBI, arsin lwuɛud i Cek ittwaggen. Ad ten kemmřeɣ i Cek s uqadi.
Maɣar Cek tfekked řeɛmar inu zi řmewt! Ma war teḥḍid iḍaren inu zeg uneqraḍ, ḥima ad uyureɣ zzat i wudem n AREBBI di Tfawt n Tudart?

footnotes.text: midden- s Tɛibranit ‘bacar’ niɣ ‘aysum’, ixs ad yini ‘bnadem’ niɣ ‘midden’ (xzar Izhd. 118:6).
